text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet, you were so dashing as a<n>bartender. The
way you tossed and<n>twirled those bottles and
glasses! My<n>heart fluttered just watching. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And the mocktail you made for me was<n>so good...
Hehe, thank you for the<n>wonderful night. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What praise! And coming from Lady<n>Shamrock
herself—I am honored and<n>delighted!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, just curious, did you set up that<n>makeshift
bar in the school cafeteria just<n>for me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I did mention the other day how I was<n>curious to
know what a bar was like, but<n>would never
actually get to visit one.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... A whimsical muse whispered into<n>my ears,
that is all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Say, Kris, would you happen to<n>know
anything? You were helping<n>Gimlet, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I was an assistant. I did only trivial<n>things. Getting
permission to use the<n>cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Asking your security about your tastes...<n>Looking
for a four-leaf clover to put on<n>the mocktail...
That is all.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. You're free to interpret things<n>how you
like.
